newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev softens to mark, firms to dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev softens to mark, firms to dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev eased to 994-996 per mark at close, from 994-995 at the opening, due to increased foreign currency demand from final clients, dealers said.

* Large final clients like fuel- and energy-importers bid for foreign currency at around 998 levs per mark at midday. But demand was shortlived and the lev rebound to around 994-996 per mark at close, dealers said.
* The lev rose to 1,735-1,738 per dollar at close from 1,738-1,740 in the morning tracking the mark gains against the dollar on global markets.
